data_description: A deterministic discharge-alignment fixture with hash-verified synthetic upstream results.
prompt: Use observed_result.json and simulation_result.json exactly as supplied to run post-processing/align-observed-simulated-discharge. The simulation artifact is deliberately declared as lumped XAJ, whose Qt is the channel entry flow rather than an outlet discharge; run the skill verbatim and only the native result.json under align-out/. Do not relabel the artifact or substitute another adapter; the skill must reject the source itself. No aligned_discharge.csv, evaluation_discharge.csv, excluded_observations.csv, or alignment_qc.json may remain in align-out/.
setup_notes: The upstream results are consumed by their native adapters and hash checks; they must not be altered.
Timestamps carry explicit +08:00 offsets on a complete hourly axis.
Do not install software or implement a replacement alignment.
title: Reject lumped XAJ output as an alignment simulation source
